rationale: The short thesis remains intact as BILI continues to trade in the lower quartile of its intraday range ($13.16) below both the declining session VWAP ($13.20) and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($13.30). Although recent 1-minute candles found temporary support at $13.12 and bounced slightly to $13.16, the price has not reclaimed VWAP or breached the $13.24 invalidation level. Elevated relative volume (4.06x) and weak broad market conditions (SPY -0.09%) continue to favor holding for a retest of lows toward the $13.00 target.
